name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer focused on the Diablillos project in Argentina's Salta province. The company completed a Definitive Feasibility Study in Q2 2026 and is advancing toward a construction decision on the high-grade silver-gold deposit. AbraSilver expanded its Salta land position in early 2026 through the acquisition of the adjacent Condoryacu and Maria Amalia properties.
